card.name: Start of hypotension after renal impairment
card.fires_on: The first piece "hyp" of the word hypotension, when it follows "risk of" or a list like "renal impairment,". It appears in warnings about dual blockade of the renin-angiotensin system.

modes.label: Hypotension in RAS warning
modes.description: The start of hypotension in a list of risks from combining ACE inhibitors, ARBs or aliskiren.
modes.example: Dual inhibition of the renin-angiotensin system: Increased risk of renal impairment,<< hyp>>otension, and hyperkalemia

card.writes: The promoted tokens look unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the start of the word hypotension in drug-interaction warnings about combining blood pressure drugs that act on the renin-angiotensin system.
